title: Easy speaking in English – level 1
paragraphs: Hello students, There is a website for you. It is www.speakinlevels.com. It is for students of English. It is for speaking.
You can find people at your level of English. You can find people from different countries. You can choose to talk to men or women.
Are you afraid of new people? Don’t worry! With Speak in Levels, you can start easily. There are tips on the website. These tips can help you.
Speak in Levels can help your English. Have fun with it!
